message.reasoning_content: We need to determine appropriate criminal charges based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: Defendant Wang 4 bought a mentally disabled woman (married) for 3000 yuan, brought her home as wife, and had sexual relations with her, knowing she has mental disability and lacks capacity to consent. She later left. This is likely "强奸罪" (rape) but with victim lacking capacity, could be "强奸罪" aggravated? Also "拐卖妇女" maybe? He bought a kidnapped woman? She was '被拐骗的已婚妇女' meaning she was abducted and trafficked. He purchased her. So crimes: "拐卖妇女" (human trafficking) and "强奸罪" (rape). Also possibly "买卖人口" (trafficking). The act of buying a trafficked person is "买卖人口罪". Also "强奸罪" because sexual intercourse with a woman lacking capacity is rape. So multiple charges: "拐卖妇女罪;强奸罪". In examples they sometimes list "强奸;侮辱" etc. So answer: [罪名]拐卖妇女;强奸<eoa>
